correctness.rationale: For q=2^m >=4, generator columns E_a=(1,a,a^2,a^3)^T and T_a=(0,1,0,a^2)^T have rank four. Projecting to first/third rows excludes <=2 circuits and all 3-/4-circuits involving fewer than three evaluation columns except derivative triples. Three distinct value columns and T_d have determinant zero iff d^2=ab+ac+bc; Hasse derivative of P(X)=(X-a)(X-b)(X-c) gives this unique d distinct from a,b,c, and proper subtriples are independent. Fix d and substitute u=(a-d)^(-1): u+v+w=0 proves PG(m-1,2) Steiner lines, (q-1)(q-2)/6 pure-value 3-helper repairs of D_d, binom(q-1,2) two-helper D_d repairs and same number of 3-helper V_a repairs. For any V_a, projection forces >=2 other V coordinates in every arbitrarily large helper set, giving <=(q-2)/2 disjoint sets; explicit primitive-power disjoint pairs and d_i=a+sqrt(g^(4i+1)) attain it since gcd(4,q-1)=1. Nonzero column multipliers do not change circuits. Finite q=4,8,16 checks are supporting tests, not an all-field proof.
